paper.title: CoMerge: Conflict-Driven Preference Optimization for Multi-Task Model Merging

summary.core_problem: 解决多任务 LLM 模型合并中的参数干扰问题，尤其是朴素合并导致某些任务能力退化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是模型合并方向的增量方法创新。价值在于把合并失败样本转化为偏好优化信号，用较轻量的系数学习替代完整重训；对预训练研究员主要是了解 post-train 阶段的能力组合和干扰处理。
summary.technical_approach: CoMerge 将模型合并重写为偏好优化问题。它利用 task arithmetic 等朴素合并方法暴露出的退化行为作为 hard negative，构造无需外部标注的偏好对；随后优化轻量的 tensor-wise merging coefficients，以缓解参数空间冲突并保留各专家模型的任务能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露参数规模、任务集合、专家模型数量、baseline 细节或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 包括 task arithmetic 等朴素合并方法，评估目标是多任务能力保持与干扰降低。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses parameter interference in multi-task LLM model merging, where naive merging can degrade task-specific capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but useful method for model merging. Its main value is turning merge failures into preference signals and learning lightweight merge coefficients instead of retraining the full model.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoMerge reformulates model merging as preference optimization. It uses degraded behaviors from naive merging methods such as task arithmetic as hard negatives to build self-supervised preference pairs, then refines lightweight tensor-wise merging coefficients to reduce parameter-space conflicts while preserving expert capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, task suites, number of expert models, or numeric improvements. The baselines include naive merging methods such as task arithmetic, with evaluation focused on retaining multi-task capabilities and reducing interference.

recommendation.zh: 思路比普通 merge 调参干净一点；看偏好对构造即可，若无跨规模实验，不必更新训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Cleaner than another merge-tuning recipe; read the preference-pair construction, but do not update training-side priors without cross-scale evidence.

paper.title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
paper.abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to p

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是企业自托管 LLM 的模型碎片化问题：大量内部应用各自绑定不同模型，GPU 池被切碎，旧模型难以下线。作者尝试用生产流量驱动的评测和 post-training，把 200 多个内部应用的请求迁移到一个统一模型上。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有实用启发。价值主要在三点：一是如何从真实生产流量构造代表性评测集，而不是只依赖公开 benchmark；二是如何把错误分析转成训练轴，包括 instruction following、function calling、内部任务分布；三是多目标 RL 容易产生 reward interference，分专家训练再做权重合并有时比联合优化更稳。对基座训练研究员来说，这类结果能帮助判断哪些能力缺口应放在 mid-training 数据里解决，哪些更适合 post-training 和在线评测闭环解决。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由评测构建和训练 recipe 两部分组成。评测侧，作者从约 100k 月度查询中采样，目标是在多样性和生产分布代表性之间折中。普通随机采样保留分布但重复模板太多；diversity-first 方法会过度偏向少见模板，破坏服务和任务分布。作者采用 template-aware sampler：先 mask 变量片段，用 LSH 聚合近似模板，在每个模板内基于变量 span 做 greedy max-min，再按 count 的平方根分配预算。评测打分也按任务分流。分类和信息抽取约占 63.2% 流量，使用参考答案打分，参考答案由 Kimi-K2.5 生成并经人工验证；总结和内容生成等开放任务保留 side-by-side judge，并加入 RubricHub 风格 checklist。训练侧，基础模型是 Qwen3-32B，使用更适合西里尔语密集文本的 tokenizer，并因延迟和生成成本约束只使用 non-reasoning mode。流程先做混合 SFT，再分别针对 instruction following、function calling、内部任务分布训练 GRPO expert，最后用两阶段 SLERP 在权重空间合并，避免把所有 reward 放在一起训练时的跨域干扰。
summary.experiments: 生产部署结果是模型在上线 6 个月后承接了平台 50% 流量，约每月 116M requests，覆盖 200 多个内部应用。评测构建方面，template-aware sampler 的平均 pairwise TF-IDF cosine distance 达到 0.953，同时比纯 diversity sampling 保持更低的 Jensen-Shannon distance，因此覆盖更广但不明显偏离生产分布。自动评测方面，统一 side-by-side judge 与专家标注一致性有限，Cohen’s κ 约 0.62，且错误与任务类型相关。任务分流后，LLM task classifier 与人工共识匹配率为 90.6% 到 99.6%。最终 task-specific pipeline 明显优于统一 SBS：reference-based 子任务 κ 从 0.63 提升到 0.88，open-ended content-generation 子任务从 0.57 提升到 0.72；内容生成使用逐条 criteria grading 加总体判断时 κ 达到 0.79。训练结果中，作者报告开源 checkpoint 在公开 benchmark 上接近内部部署版本，用来说明 recipe 本身贡献较大，而不完全依赖私有数据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。优先看生产流量采样和 Arena 构建部分，尤其是 Table 1、Table 2、Table 10、Table 12，这些内容对构造真实业务分布评测集更有参考意义。训练部分重点看分 GRPO expert 与两阶段 SLERP 合并的设计，以及作者记录的 reward hacking 和 reward interference 案例。无需细读所有企业应用细节。对基座研究更有用的问题是：生产错误中的哪些模式应该回流到 mid-training 数据 mixture，哪些只需要 post-training；以及内部评测集如何避免被后续训练反复过拟合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses model fragmentation in enterprise self-hosted LLM deployments. Many internal applications depend on different local models, old models are hard to retire, and a fixed GPU pool becomes inefficient. The proposed solution is to consolidate traffic onto a single adapted model by using production-error analysis, production-shaped evaluation, and targeted post-training.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training and evaluation paper, not a base pre-training paper. Its relevance to pre-training research comes from the feedback loop between production traffic and training objectives. It gives a concrete example of how real request distributions differ from public benchmarks, how to turn failure analysis into training axes, and why joint multi-objective RL can be unstable when rewards interfere. For base-model researchers, the useful signal is deciding which gaps should be handled by mid-training data mixture design and which are better repaired through post-training plus production-aligned evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. The evaluation pipeline samples from roughly 100k monthly production queries while balancing diversity and representativeness. Uniform sampling preserves the production distribution but keeps many near-duplicate templates. Diversity-first sampling increases coverage but distorts the service and task mix. The paper introduces a template-aware sampler: mask variable spans, cluster near-identical normalized prompts with LSH, select diverse examples within each template using greedy max-min over variable spans, and allocate budget proportional to the square root of template count. Scoring is task-specific. Classification and information extraction, about 63.2% of traffic, use reference-based evaluation with gold answers generated by Kimi-K2.5 and checked by annotators. Open-ended summarization and generation use side-by-side judging augmented with checklist-style rubrics. The training recipe starts from Qwen3-32B with a Cyrillic-dense tokenizer and runs in non-reasoning mode for latency and cost reasons. It performs a combined SFT stage, then trains separate GRPO experts for instruction following, function calling, and internal task-distribution alignment. The experts are merged with two-stage SLERP in weight space to avoid cross-domain reward interference from a single joint RL objective.
summary_en.experiments: The deployed adapted model absorbed 50% of platform traffic six months after rollout, corresponding to 116 million requests per month from more than 200 internal applications. On benchmark construction, the template-aware sampler reaches a mean pairwise TF-IDF cosine distance of 0.953 while keeping Jensen-Shannon distances lower than pure diversity sampling, indicating better coverage without strongly drifting from production mix. For judging, a uniform side-by-side LLM judge has limited agreement with experts, with Cohen’s kappa around 0.62 and task-dependent errors. After task routing, the LLM task classifier matches human consensus 90.6% to 99.6% of the time. The final task-specific judging pipeline improves agreement: reference-based subtasks rise from kappa 0.63 to 0.88, and open-ended content-generation subtasks rise from 0.57 to 0.72. For content generation, explicit per-criterion grading plus an overall verdict reaches kappa 0.79. The authors also release an open-weight checkpoint trained without internal data and report that it is close to the deployed model on public benchmarks, suggesting that the recipe contributes substantially beyond private traffic data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. The most useful parts are the production sampling and Arena construction sections, especially Table 1, Table 2, Table 10, and Table 12. These sections give practical details on building an evaluation set that is both representative and non-redundant. In the training section, focus on the separate GRPO experts, two-stage SLERP merge, and the documented reward-hacking or reward-interference cases. The enterprise-specific application details are less important. The main follow-up questions are how production failures should feed back into mid-training mixtures, how to prevent overfitting to an internal evaluation set, and when weight-space merging is preferable to joint RL.

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励失效和 SLERP 合并部分；生产 setup 不够可复现，但比公开榜单更接近真实后训练问题。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-failure and SLERP-merge parts; the production setup is not very reproducible, but it is closer to real post-training than public leaderboard chasing.

paper.title: DARTS: Decoder-Aware Representation Tuning via Surgery for Model Merging
paper.abstract: Model merging combines multiple task-specific fine-tuned LLMs into a single multi-task model without additional training. However, merged models are known to suffer from representation bias: systematic drift between the merged model's hidden states and those of each individual source model. Prior work (Yang et al., 2024a) study and mitigate this bias for encoder-based vision models using a lightweight correction module trained with L1 loss. However, such bias is not studied for decoder models du

summary.core_problem: 如何解决自回归解码器模型在模型融合（Model Merging）过程中产生的表示偏差（Representation Bias）问题？
summary.importance: 首次针对自回归解码器模型分析并缓解了模型融合中的表示偏差，指出了因果掩码和不同 token 熵值带来的独特挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DARTS (Decoder-Aware Representation Tuning via Surgery)，通过位置感知的修正模块（处理因果掩码带来的偏差累积）和基于熵的加权机制（赋予高熵/决策关键位置更高的权重）来对齐融合模型的隐藏状态与源模型。
summary.experiments: 在多个任务上验证了 DARTS 的有效性，相比于未修正的融合模型和针对编码器设计的修正方法，性能有所提升。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the representation bias that occurs during model merging for autoregressive decoder models?
summary_en.importance: First to analyze and mitigate representation bias in merged autoregressive decoder models, highlighting unique challenges posed by causal masks and varying token entropies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DARTS (Decoder-Aware Representation Tuning via Surgery), which uses a position-aware correction module (to handle bias accumulation from causal masking) and an entropy-based weighting mechanism (to prioritize high-entropy/decision-critical positions) to align the hidden states of the merged model with the source models.
summary_en.experiments: Validated DARTS on multiple tasks, showing improved performance compared to uncorrected merged models and correction methods designed for encoders.

recommendation.zh: 模型融合在后训练阶段有一定应用，本文指出了 decoder 架构在 merging 时的特殊性（因果掩码导致偏差累积，高熵 token 更重要），作为 literature 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Model merging has applications in post-training; this paper points out the specificities of decoder architectures during merging (bias accumulation due to causal masks, importance of high-entropy tokens). Keep as literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families
paper.abstract: Model merging enables combining multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, but its safety implications remain poorly understood. Prior work primarily attributes merging risks to unsafe constituent models, implicitly assuming that merging individually aligned models preserves safety. In contrast, we show that model merging reveals a previously overlooked jailbreak risk rooted in the pretrained foundation model, even when all constituent models are individually safety-aligned. Motivat

summary.core_problem: 论文研究模型合并后的安全风险，重点不是某个不安全子模型污染合并结果，而是多个已对齐微调模型共享同一个预训练基座时，参数合并可能暴露基座中保留下来的脆弱方向。攻击者不知道具体合并系数和所有成员 checkpoint，只知道这些合并模型来自同一预训练 backbone，并希望构造一个能跨合并族迁移的通用 jailbreak suffix。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的启发在于：安全行为可能更多是 post-training 对预训练能力的抑制，而不是能力删除。模型合并会扰动这些抑制机制，使共享基座中的有害能力重新变得可触发。它提醒基座研究员，预训练阶段保留的能力边界、微调后的参数盆地结构、以及 alignment 的可组合性需要一起评估。对开放模型生态里的 merge checkpoint 尤其相关，因为合并常被当成低成本能力复用手段，但安全性质不一定随 constituent model 的单独安全性保持。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把同源微调模型的合并写成参数空间中的系数组合，例如 task arithmetic 中用 θ_pre 加上多个 task vector 的线性组合。核心假设是：来自同一预训练模型的多个微调/合并 checkpoint 往往位于连通的低损失 basin 内，因此它们的脆弱方向并非独立。BAJ 将 jailbreak suffix 的搜索建模为关于合并系数的 min-max 优化：外层寻找一个 suffix，内层在可行合并系数集合中选择最难攻击、最安全的合并配置。这样得到的 suffix 不会只拟合单个 checkpoint，而是被迫对整个合并 basin 中共享的脆弱方向有效。与普通 GCG 式单模型 suffix 搜索相比，BAJ 的区别在于优化目标覆盖一族可能的 merged models；与只检测 unsafe constituent contamination 的工作相比，它把风险来源定位到共享预训练基座和合并扰动之间的交互。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在不同 merged model family 和不同合并设置上，BAJ 都能取得稳定的高攻击成功率，并且攻击可以跨独立对齐的合并模型迁移。这支持两个结论：第一，单个 aligned constituent 安全并不能推出合并模型族安全；第二，共享 backbone 可能携带可被合并过程放大的攻击方向。提供内容中没有完整实验表格，因此无法确认具体 ASR、模型家族、合并算法数量、suffix 长度、harmful benchmark 或防御设置。需要精查实验部分才能判断该攻击相对单模型 GCG、随机合并采样攻击、以及只对若干端点优化的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议花 20-30 分钟。优先看 threat model，确认攻击者知道什么、不知道什么，以及目标是单个 merged checkpoint 还是整个同源 merged family。随后看 BAJ 的 min-max 目标和内层合并系数搜索，这是方法核心。实验部分重点看三类对照：只攻击一个 merged model 的 suffix、在多个端点上联合优化的 suffix、以及 BAJ 对未知合并系数的迁移结果。若关心预训练和对齐接口，还应看作者如何论证 vulnerability 来自共享 backbone，而不是来自某个 downstream checkpoint 的安全退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a safety failure mode in model merging. The target is not contamination from an unsafe constituent model. Instead, it asks whether merging individually aligned models that share the same pretrained backbone can expose vulnerable directions inherited from that backbone. The attacker aims to build one adversarial suffix that transfers across a family of merged models without knowing the exact merge coefficients or all constituent checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: The pretraining relevance is the interaction between retained pretrained capabilities and post-training suppression. If alignment mainly suppresses harmful capabilities rather than removing them, parameter merging can perturb the suppression mechanism and make shared vulnerabilities reachable again. This matters for open model ecosystems where merged checkpoints are widely used as a cheap capability-composition tool. It also suggests that safety evaluation should cover merge families and parameter-space neighborhoods, not only individual aligned checkpoints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup represents merged models as combinations of finetuned checkpoints derived from a common pretrained model. In task arithmetic, this is expressed as the pretrained parameter vector plus a weighted sum of task vectors. The key assumption is that such merged models lie in a connected low-loss basin, so their vulnerabilities are correlated. Basin-Aware Jailbreak formulates suffix search as a min-max problem over merge coefficients: the suffix is optimized to succeed against the hardest, most safety-preserving model inside the feasible merge region. This encourages the suffix to capture directions shared by the whole basin rather than overfitting to a single checkpoint. Compared with standard single-model suffix optimization, the target distribution is a parameter-space family. Compared with prior merging-safety work focused on unsafe constituents, the risk is attributed to the shared pretrained backbone and its interaction with parameter aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistently high attack success rates across diverse merged model families and merge settings, with suffixes transferring across independently aligned merged models. The results support two claims: safety of each constituent checkpoint does not guarantee safety of the merged family, and common pretrained backbones can preserve vulnerability directions that merging exposes. The supplied content does not include exact ASR values, model families, merge algorithms, suffix lengths, harmful-instruction datasets, or defense settings. Those numbers are needed to assess the margin over single-checkpoint GCG, endpoint-only joint optimization, and random merge sampling baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20-30 minutes. Start with the threat model to understand what the attacker knows and what must generalize. Then read the BAJ objective, especially the min-max optimization over merge coefficients. In the experiments, compare BAJ against suffixes optimized for one merged model, suffixes trained on a small set of endpoints, and attacks evaluated on unseen merge coefficients. For pretraining and alignment questions, pay attention to the evidence that the vulnerability comes from the shared backbone rather than a degraded downstream checkpoint.

recommendation.zh: 值得看威胁模型和 min-max 目标；它把合并安全问题拉回预训练 basin，结论要靠完整 ASR 表验证。
recommendation.en: Skim the threat model and min-max objective; the useful bit is tying merge safety back to the pretrained basin, with ASR tables deciding credibility.

paper.title: Escaping Low-Dimensional Overlap: Multi-Task Model Merging via High-Dimensional Sparse Disentanglement
paper.abstract: Model merging provides an efficient way to construct multi-task generalist models without additional training, but its performance often degrades under severe task interference. Task interference in model merging primarily stems from \textit{superposition}, where task-specific features become entangled within the parameter space. This entanglement renders conventional decomposition methods insufficient for effectively isolating useful task directions from interfering components. In this paper, w

summary.core_problem: 多任务模型合并在任务冲突严重时容易退化，原因是 task-specific features 在参数空间中发生 superposition，难以直接分离后再融合。
summary.importance: 这是模型合并方向的技术改进，贡献是把 task vector 投影到高维稀疏特征空间做 disentanglement，并用轻量零阶优化选择关键层。对预训练本身不是核心，但对后续多任务适配、checkpoint 融合和参数空间分析有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出基于 Sparse Autoencoder 的 merging 框架：先把 task vectors 映射到高维稀疏表示中，以 feature-level 而非 parameter-level 进行解缠，再执行融合；同时引入 Group-Ranked Zeroth-Order Optimizer（GR-ZOO）筛选 task-critical layers，只在关键层做 selective merging，以降低计算开销并减少干扰。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 上进行，摘要称其持续优于现有 representation decomposition 与 merging baseline，但未给出具体任务集合、指标和提升幅度。结论更像方法可行性信号，是否能扩展到更大模型和更异质任务仍待验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-task model merging often degrades under strong task interference because task-specific features are superposed in parameter space and cannot be cleanly separated before fusion.
summary_en.importance: This is a model-merging improvement paper. Its main contribution is to move disentanglement into a high-dimensional sparse feature space and to use lightweight zeroth-order layer selection. It is not central to pretraining, but it may matter for post-hoc adaptation and checkpoint fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a Sparse Autoencoder to project task vectors into a high-dimensional sparse representation, enabling feature-level disentanglement before merging. It also introduces Group-Ranked Zeroth-Order Optimization (GR-ZOO) to identify task-critical layers and perform selective merging with lower overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B. The abstract claims consistent gains over representation-decomposition and model-merging baselines, but does not specify task suites, metrics, or margins. At this stage, it reads as a promising feasibility result rather than a settled recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但“先稀疏解缠再 merge”这个想法值得记；只看方法图和消融，别急着把它当通用 recipe。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the sparse-disentangle-then-merge idea is worth noting; read the method and ablations, not as a universal recipe yet.

paper.title: GRIP: Granular Reward-Guided Parameter Interpolation for Efficient Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning-oriented large language models often achieve strong problem-solving performance by generating long chains of thought, but this behavior substantially increases inference cost and latency. In contrast, instruction-tuned models tend to answer more concisely, yet often lack comparable reasoning ability. This accuracy-efficiency mismatch motivates a lightweight approach that combines the strengths of both models without full model retraining. In this paper, we propose GRIP (Granular Reward

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是推理模型“答得准但太长”和指令模型“答得短但推理弱”之间的取舍问题。目标是在不做完整微调的情况下，把同架构推理模型和非思考型指令模型融合成一个更省 token、但尽量保留推理准确率的模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 post-train 与推理效率接口有启发。它把模型合并从固定全局系数推进到模块级、奖励驱动的可学习插值，可以用来分析哪些层或模块更偏向承载推理行为，哪些模块可以向简洁指令行为移动。这个方向适合看作低成本行为调节方法，而不是新的基座训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: GRIP 假设两个源模型来自同一模型族、架构一致、参数空间大致对齐。对每个模块设置一个可学习插值 logit，经 sigmoid 映射成系数 alpha，用 alpha 乘推理模型参数、用 1-alpha 乘指令模型参数，得到融合模型。训练时冻结两个源模型，只更新这些模块级插值系数。优化信号来自 rollout 后的奖励，奖励同时考虑答案正确性和输出长度，形式上借鉴 GRPO 的 group-relative 更新。相比固定比例 merge 或黑盒搜索，它的粒度更细，且能用任务奖励直接推动融合方向。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段只说明实验显示 GRIP 在准确率与输出长度之间优于已有 merge baseline，并能呈现模块级插值模式；未提供完整表格、数据集、模型规模、token 节省比例或准确率提升数字。可确认的实验目标是比较 reasoning model、instruction model、固定系数插值、搜索式合并与 GRIP 的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off，并观察不同 attention、FFN、embedding、LM head 模块的 learned alpha 分布。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–20 分钟。重点看 Method 中模块级插值参数化和 RL 更新推导，确认梯度如何只通过 rho 传播而不更新源模型权重。实验部分若可获得，应优先看三类内容：不同任务上的准确率-长度曲线、相对固定插值的增益、learned alpha 的层级分布。真正值得深挖的是模块级 alpha 是否稳定、是否能跨任务迁移，以及 reward 中长度惩罚会不会牺牲复杂题的必要推理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the mismatch between reasoning models that solve problems well but produce long chains of thought, and instruction-tuned models that answer concisely but often reason less reliably. The goal is to obtain a cheaper reasoning model by merging two same-architecture models without full-model retraining.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to the post-training and inference-efficiency interface than to base pretraining. Its useful idea is to turn model merging into a module-wise, reward-guided control problem. This can also serve as a diagnostic tool: learned interpolation ratios may indicate which modules need to stay close to the reasoning model and which can move toward the concise instruction model.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRIP starts from a reasoning-oriented model and a non-thinking instruction model from the same family. For each module, it learns an interpolation logit, maps it through a sigmoid to obtain a coefficient, and linearly combines the corresponding parameters from the two frozen source models. Only the interpolation logits are updated. The fused model generates responses, receives a reward based on correctness and response length, and updates the module-wise coefficients with a GRPO-style group-relative objective. Compared with global coefficient merging or black-box coefficient search, the method provides finer control and uses task reward directly.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt states that GRIP improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over existing merging baselines and reveals module-wise patterns related to reasoning behavior. It does not include the full experimental tables, model sizes, benchmark list, accuracy gains, or token-reduction numbers. The key experiments to verify are comparisons against the original reasoning model, the instruction model, fixed interpolation, and search-based merging, together with layer-wise alpha visualizations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is enough. Focus on the method section: the module-wise parameterization, the reward definition, and how gradients are propagated only into interpolation logits. In the experiments, prioritize accuracy-versus-length curves, ablations over interpolation granularity, and learned coefficient patterns across attention, FFN, embedding, and LM-head modules. The main question to examine is whether the learned ratios are task-specific artifacts or stable indicators of where reasoning behavior is stored.

recommendation.zh: 值得看模块级插值和 reward 设计；若实验干净，可作为低成本压短推理链的内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Skim the module-wise interpolation and reward design; if the setup is clean, it is a good internal ablation for shortening reasoning traces.

paper.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
paper.abstract: Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering. We propose IAR (Inject, Align, and Recover), a three-stage post-training framework that separates structured document knowledge injection, QA behavior alignment, and general ability recover

summary.core_problem: 让 LLM 在不检索原文档的情况下，把一个固定文档集合转化为可回答问题的参数化知识。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练 recipe。它把文档知识内化拆成注入、问答对齐和能力恢复三个阶段，试图缓解 continued pretraining 容易带来的问答行为不足和通用能力损失。对 pretrain researcher 的价值在于观察“知识写入参数”和“保留通用能力”之间的接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IAR：Inject 阶段把源文档转换为 continuation、rewrite、instruction-conditioned reconstruction 等训练目标；Align 阶段用 answer-only QA supervision 对齐问答行为；Recover 阶段把领域适配模型与基础指令模型合并，以恢复通用能力。方法属于 staged post-training，而不是单纯继续预训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 Common Corpus 和 CCI 上实验，覆盖 Llama、Phi、Qwen、SmolLM 多个模型家族。主要比较 retrieval-free QA 场景下的领域能力与通用能力 trade-off，并报告 IAR 改善 domain-primary 与 domain-general frontier；摘要未给出参数规模和具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to turn a fixed document collection into parametric knowledge that an LLM can use for retrieval-free question answering.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training recipe contribution. It decomposes document knowledge internalization into injection, QA alignment, and general-capability recovery, addressing the mismatch between continued pretraining and answer behavior. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the interface between writing knowledge into weights and preserving general capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: IAR has three stages. Inject converts documents into continuation, rewrite, and instruction-conditioned reconstruction objectives. Align then trains the model with answer-only QA supervision. Recover merges the domain-adapted model with the base instruction model to regain general abilities. The method is a staged post-training approach rather than plain continual pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on Common Corpus and CCI across Llama, Phi, Qwen, and SmolLM families. The main evaluation is the frontier between domain-specific retrieval-free QA and general capability. Exact model sizes and improvement numbers are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 continual pretrain 的负例对照看；重点读 Inject 目标和 Recover 合并，别被文档 QA 场景带偏。
recommendation.en: Use it as a counterpoint to naive continual pretraining; read the Inject objectives and Recover merge, not the document-QA framing.

paper.title: HyperFix: Combinatorial Nonlinear Correction for Task Vector Merging
paper.abstract: Task vectors enable model merging without joint retraining. In practice, the subset of task vectors to be merged may vary, but many existing methods use scalar tuning for a particular subset, requiring repeated tuning across subsets and restricting task vector merging to linear rescaling. We therefore formulate merging across varying task subsets as a combinatorial correction problem and introduce HyperFix, a lightweight hypernetwork that predicts subset-conditioned nonlinear corrections in weig

summary.core_problem: 现有任务向量合并方法多针对特定子集做标量调优，需随子集变化重复调优，且仅支持线性缩放，无法适配任意任务子集组合的非线性修正需求。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将变子集任务向量合并形式化为组合修正问题，提出轻量超网络方案，避免逐子集重复调优。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HyperFix轻量超网络，仅在任务库的单子集、双子集、三子集组合上训练一次，即可预测任意更大子集条件下的权重空间非线性修正；辅以局部扰动分析给出线性合并残差的理论上界，支撑从小任务更新学习修正的合理性。
summary.experiments: 在多类多任务基准上测试，相比现有任务向量合并方法效果更优，同时显著降低调优成本，具体参数量与基线细节摘要未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing task vector merging methods rely on subset-specific scalar tuning, requiring repeated optimization across subsets and being limited to linear rescaling, which fails for arbitrary task subset combinations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first formulates varying-subset task vector merging as a combinatorial correction problem, proposing a lightweight hypernetwork to avoid per-subset tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce HyperFix, a lightweight hypernetwork trained once on singleton, pair, and triple subsets from a task bank, capable of predicting subset-conditioned nonlinear corrections in weight space for larger unseen subsets; complemented by local perturbation analysis bounding the residual beyond linear merging, justifying learning corrections from small task updates.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across diverse multi-task benchmarks, outperforming existing task vector merging methods while significantly reducing tuning cost; specific parameter counts and baseline details are not fully disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 任务向量合并的增量改进，局部扰动分析有一定理论参考，仅看§3的上界推导即可，无需复现。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to task vector merging; the local perturbation bound in §3 has modest theoretical value, no reproduction needed.

paper.title: Orientation, not magnitude: the causal structure of task-vector interference in merged language models
paper.abstract: Model merging by task arithmetic works until it doesn't, and the field diagnoses why with magnitudes: layerwise representation bias, deviations from cross-task linearity, parameter overlap. Tracking the exact layerwise cross-term of merged LLMs through a factorial ledger and intervening on it directly, we find magnitude insufficient - and inconsistent across model families - as a diagnostic axis. An exact decomposition of the layerwise flux shows it is dominated by amplifying transport of the ex

summary.core_problem: 解释 task-vector model merging 中不同任务相互干扰的因果结构，尤其判断干扰来自向量大小还是方向。
summary.importance: 这是模型合并和参数空间机制分析工作。它对 continual finetuning、能力合成、checkpoint arithmetic 有参考意义，因为这些场景常用 task vector，但现有诊断多看 norm、overlap 或线性偏差，未必能解释干扰真正如何传播。
summary.technical_approach: 论文追踪 merged LLM 每层 cross-term 的精确分解，用 factorial ledger 分账，并直接干预该 cross-term。核心分析包括 layerwise flux decomposition、在不同层擦除 cross-term、从六个起始 displacement 做 basin test，以及用同 norm 但错误方向的控制向量做因果对照。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在两个模型家族上观察到一致现象：late block 中已有 cross-term 的 amplifying transport 占主导，约 65-70%，每个 late block gain 大于 1；如果不在靠近输出处擦除，传播会把 cross-term 重建到 99% norm 且 cosine 0.99。沿正确方向擦除会按剂量移除 expressed interference，而同 norm 错误方向控制无效或效果弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes the causal structure of task-vector interference in merged language models, asking whether interference is governed by magnitude or direction.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic study of model merging and parameter-space composition. It matters for continual finetuning, capability merging, and checkpoint arithmetic, where task vectors are often used but interference diagnostics are usually based on norms, overlap, or linearity deviations.
summary_en.technical_approach: It tracks the exact layerwise cross-term in merged LLMs through a factorial ledger and intervenes on that term directly. The analysis includes layerwise flux decomposition, cross-term erasure at different depths, basin tests from six starting displacements, and norm-matched wrong-direction controls.
summary_en.experiments: Across two model families, the cross-term flux is dominated by amplifying transport of the existing cross-term, around 65-70%, with gain above 1 in late blocks. Erasing the term is undone by propagation unless applied near the output, rebuilding to 99% of its norm at cosine 0.99. Directional erasure removes expressed interference dose-dependently, while norm-matched wrong-direction controls fail or are much weaker.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 后看干预实验；“方向而非大小”若成立，会改变 task-vector merge 的调参诊断轴。
recommendation.en: Read the intervention results after the abstract; if the direction-over-magnitude claim holds, it changes the diagnostic axis for task-vector merging.

paper.title: CHORUS: Complementary Experts for High-Coverage Testbench Stimulus Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced code generation, where executable feedback provides a more reliable learning signal than textual imitation alone. Hardware verification is an important application of code generation and accounts for a substantial fraction of modern chip design effort, with high-coverage testbench stimulus generation as a key task. We present CHORUS, a post-training framework that pushes performance beyond what a conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT)-to-reinforcemen

summary.core_problem: 硬件验证领域的高覆盖率测试激励生成任务中，传统SFT到RL的单模型后训练流水线易出现性能饱和，单纯扩大模型规模对这类专业工程任务提升有限。
summary.importance: 对后训练与预训练衔接的启发：分阶段SFT产生的中间checkpoint天然具备行为多样性，经相同RL优化后可形成总性能相当但任务级优势互补的专家模型，突破了单模型RL的性能瓶颈，为代码、推理等密集奖励场景的后训练范式提供了新思路；自适应多教师on-policy蒸馏的方法能在不增加参数量的前提下整合多专家优势，也是高效后训练的可行方向。
summary.technical_approach: CHORUS是面向测试激励生成的三阶段后训练框架：1）保留分阶段SFT的所有中间checkpoint，对每个checkpoint独立执行相同的执行引导RL（采用DAPO优化，联合训练直接生成与智能体修复两种模式，奖励基于仿真器覆盖率信号），得到多个总性能接近但任务优势互补的专家模型；2）提供两种专家整合方案：免训练的权重平均可直接获得性能提升，自适应多教师on-policy蒸馏则按任务选择奖励最高的专家作为教师，仅当教师优于学生时才执行蒸馏，避免引入劣化行为。
summary.experiments: 最终模型仅4B参数，在CVDP-ECov基准上Pass@1达88.0%，比671B参数的DeepSeek-R1高出13.5个百分点。实验验证了分阶段SFT中间checkpoint经RL后确实形成互补专家（不同专家在不同任务上占优，分歧任务上覆盖率差距显著），两种整合方案均突破了单专家的性能饱和点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中「单模型RL饱和」与「分阶段SFT多样性价值」的核心观察，以及图2的框架总览；再读第3节方法，重点理解互补专家的产生机制与自适应多教师蒸馏的设计；实验部分关注主结果与专家互补性的分析，预计阅读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: For high-coverage testbench stimulus generation in hardware verification, the conventional single-model post-training pipeline of SFT followed by RL hits a performance saturation point, and simply scaling model size delivers limited gains for this specialized engineering task.
summary_en.importance: Insights for post-training and pretraining-posttraining interfaces: intermediate checkpoints from staged SFT inherently carry behavioral diversity, and when optimized with the same RL procedure, they become experts with comparable aggregate performance but complementary task-level strengths. This breaks the single-model RL saturation ceiling and offers a new post-training paradigm for dense-reward domains like code and reasoning. The adaptive multi-teacher on-policy distillation method also provides a parameter-efficient way to integrate multi-expert strengths.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHORUS is a three-stage post-training framework for testbench stimulus generation: 1) It retains all intermediate checkpoints from staged SFT, and applies the same execution-guided RL procedure to each independently (optimized with DAPO, jointly training direct generation and agentic refinement modes, with rewards derived from simulator coverage signals), producing multiple experts with similar aggregate performance but complementary task-level advantages. 2) Two expert consolidation schemes are provided: training-free weight averaging delivers immediate gains, while adaptive multi-teacher on-policy distillation selects the highest-reward expert per task as teacher, and only distills when the teacher outperforms the student to avoid degrading behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The final 4B-parameter model achieves 88.0% Pass@1 on the CVDP-ECov benchmark, 13.5 percentage points higher than the 671B-parameter DeepSeek-R1. Experiments confirm that RL-trained experts from staged SFT checkpoints are indeed complementary (different experts excel on different tasks, with large coverage gaps on disagreed tasks), and both consolidation schemes surpass the single-expert saturation point.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the core observations in the introduction (single-model RL saturation, value of staged SFT diversity) and Figure 2 for the framework overview. Then read Section 3 for the method, focusing on complementary expert generation and adaptive multi-teacher distillation. For experiments, look at the main results and analysis of expert complementarity. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 核心 insight 是 staged SFT 产生互补专家再合并，对 RL 后训练中如何利用行为多样性有参考价值，重点看专家多样性与合并策略那一节。
recommendation.en: The key insight is using staged SFT to produce complementary experts then merging them; useful for leveraging behavioral diversity in RL post-training—focus on the expert diversity and merging section.

paper.title: When Skills Meet Safety: Benchmarking and Characterizing the Adaptive Jailbreak Robustness of Skill-Merged LLMs
paper.abstract: Model merging has become the default way to give an aligned language model new skills without retraining: a practitioner folds task vectors from math, code, or domain specialists into a safety-aligned base using task arithmetic, TIES, or DARE. This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few

summary.core_problem: 现有技能合并LLM的安全评估仅依赖静态拒绝测试，无法反映真实自适应攻击下的鲁棒性，静态安全指标具有误导性。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+分析贡献，首次提出针对技能合并LLM的自适应越狱鲁棒性评测基准SkillSafe-Bench，系统揭示静态安全与真实攻击鲁棒性的显著脱节。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SkillSafe-Bench，采用保守的双裁判AND规则，从静态拒绝率、自适应越狱鲁棒性、能力保留三个维度评测技能合并模型；使用语义模板攻击等自适应攻击方法测试鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 覆盖6个开源基座（5个模型族，2种规模），发现脆弱基座上静态表现安全的合并模型在语义模板攻击下越狱成功率大幅上升，静态安全无法预测自适应攻击鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing safety evaluations of skill-merged LLMs rely solely on static refusal tests, which fail to reflect robustness under real adaptive attacks, making static safety metrics misleading.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and analytical contribution: first proposes SkillSafe-Bench for evaluating adaptive jailbreak robustness of skill-merged LLMs, and systematically reveals the significant disconnect between static safety and real attack robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds SkillSafe-Bench with a conservative two-judge AND rule, evaluating skill-merged models on three dimensions: static refusal rate, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention; uses adaptive attacks like semantic template attacks to test robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 6 open-weight bases (5 families, 2 scales); finds that merges appearing safe on fragile bases have much higher jailbreak rates under semantic template attacks, and static safety does not predict adaptive attack robustness.

recommendation.zh: 静态安全测试完全无法预测技能合并模型的自适应越狱鲁棒性，做模型合并与对齐的研究员重点看§3基准设计和§4脱节分析。
recommendation.en: Static safety tests fail to predict adaptive jailbreak robustness in skill-merged LLMs; researchers in model merging and alignment should focus on §3 benchmark design and §4 disconnect analysis.

paper.title: Hyper-ES: Effective Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning via Descent Direction Merging
paper.abstract: Evolution Strategy (ES) is a promising alternative to gradient-based fine-tuning for resource-constrained Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, directly applying ES to billion-parameter LLMs is highly ineffective. In such high-dimensional parameter spaces, most random perturbations are nearly orthogonal to useful update directions, leading to unstable optimization. We propose Hyper-ES, a subspace-based ES framework that avoids the weakness of ES in full-parameter search while exploiting

summary.core_problem: 直接将进化策略(ES)应用于十亿参数LLM推理微调效果极差，高维参数空间中随机扰动几乎与有用更新方向正交，导致优化不稳定。
summary.importance: 方法改进：提出子空间ES框架，用少量廉价梯度微调获取下降方向构造低维子空间，再在子空间内做CMA-ES优化，规避全参数ES的高维诅咒。
summary.technical_approach: Hyper-ES先运行少量梯度微调得到若干下降方向，其张成空间作为适配子空间；然后用CMA-ES在该子空间中优化逐层DARE-TIES合并权重。
summary.experiments: 在LLM推理任务上对比全参数ES和梯度微调，子空间ES以更低计算成本取得更稳定的优化效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of evolution strategies to billion-parameter LLM reasoning fine-tuning is highly ineffective, as random perturbations in high-dimensional parameter space are nearly orthogonal to useful update directions, causing unstable optimization.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement: a subspace-based ES framework that uses cheap gradient fine-tuning runs to construct a low-dimensional descent subspace, then applies CMA-ES within it, avoiding the high-dimensional curse of full-parameter ES.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hyper-ES first runs a small number of inexpensive gradient-based fine-tuning runs to obtain descent directions whose span forms a compact adaptation subspace; CMA-ES then optimizes layer-wise DARE-TIES merging weights within this subspace.
summary_en.experiments: Compared to full-parameter ES and gradient fine-tuning on LLM reasoning tasks, subspace ES achieves more stable optimization at lower compute cost.

recommendation.zh: 子空间ES+模型合并的思路有一定新意，但属于后训练微调范畴，对预训练研究员参考价值有限，看摘要和方法即可。
recommendation.en: Subspace ES plus model merging has some novelty but sits in post-training fine-tuning; limited reference for pretraining researchers, read abstract and method only.

paper.title: Understanding Knowledge Transfer Mechanism in Heterogeneous MLLM Fusion: A Simple Linear Approach
paper.abstract: Training-free fusion of heterogeneous multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provides a direct route for cross-scale capability transfer, yet improvements in aggregate performance do not reveal what a smaller model actually inherits. Existing studies are largely designed and evaluated on limited task sets or aggregate metrics; as evaluation expands to broader task collections, whether different capabilities can transfer across scales remains poorly understood. To investigate this question, we

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“融合后总分有没有涨”，而是更细的三个问题：跨尺度、异构的 MLLM 在训练免费融合时，究竟哪些能力能从大模型转到小模型；这些能力主要寄存在什么参数和什么模块里；层对齐、参数选择和注入强度为什么会决定转移是否有效。作者指出，已有 heterogeneous fusion 工作大多只看聚合指标，难以区分真实知识迁移、结构失配带来的干扰、以及不同能力之间的非均匀变化。为此，他们把“融合”降成一个局部线性探针问题，用很小幅度的参数方向注入去测 transfer signal，而不是直接追求一次性最优融合结果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的可部署融合算法，而在于给出了一套分析跨模型知识可迁移性的可操作框架。它把参数空间中的迁移拆成一阶有益信号和二阶结构干扰两部分，这个视角对理解 model merging、continual pretrain、跨尺寸蒸馏、甚至 mid-training 阶段的参数迁移都很有参考价值。更具体地说，结论是：跨尺度迁移明显具有能力选择性，高层推理比感知更容易迁移；LLM 部分比视觉编码器更承载这类可迁移增益；有效迁移只出现在很窄的小注入区间。这些观察对“哪些能力是局部线性可搬运的，哪些能力强依赖整体表征几何”给出了较清楚的经验边界。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CDPI，Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection。给定同一家族中较大的 source MLLM 和较小的 target MLLM，先把模型拆成 ViT、跨模态 projector、LLM 三个组件，再定义注入空间 E=(C,P)：C 决定注入哪些组件，P 决定只注入 linear-layer 参数还是注入所有可对齐参数。由于 source 和 target 在 hidden size、attention head 数、LLM 深度上都不同，作者构造了异构对齐算子 A_pi，把 source 参数投影到 target 参数空间。这里的 pi 是 LLM 层映射策略，决定深层到浅层、均匀抽样还是其他配对方式。得到投影方向 ΔΘ 后，不做训练，只沿着这个方向对 target 做小步移动：Θ_F = Θ_T + αΔ。关键不在大步融合，而在扫描 α、组件、参数子集和层映射，观察不同能力的局部响应。

理论部分用了 target 点附近的二阶展开。对某一能力类别 c 的泛化损失 L_c(Θ)，局部增益近似写成 αA_c - 1/2 α^2 I_c，其中 A_c = -∇L_c(Θ_T)^TΔ 表示一阶 transfer signal，衡量 source 投影方向是否与该能力的改进方向对齐；I_c = Δ^T H_c Δ 表示二阶 curvature response，刻画结构失配、参数耦合和局部曲率带来的干扰。这个分解很重要，因为它解释了为什么同一个 source 方向会对 reasoning 有帮助、对 perception 几乎无效，或者在 α 稍大时迅速转负：不是没有信号，而是二阶干扰开始主导。

和常见 model merging 不同，这里不追求构造一个全局最优 merged model，也不依赖训练 learned mapping。它更像一个诊断工具：通过受控的小幅参数注入，测量不同模块和不同参数类型的可迁移性。作者还特别比较了 linear 参数与 full 参数，发现线性层权重往往具有更高的 transfer efficiency，这暗示可迁移知识更集中在可直接作用于表示变换的主干线性映射，而不是所有可对齐参数平均分布。
summary.experiments:
实验基于四组 Qwen3-VL 跨尺度模型对，在 12 个 benchmark 上分析 transfer pattern。全文给出的主结果不是单一总分，而是按能力拆分后的变化。最稳定的发现有四点。

第一，增益主要集中在 reasoning，尤其是 high-level reasoning；perception 类任务基本贴着 target 原始水平，变化很小。这说明跨尺度训练免费融合更像是在搬运高层决策或语言推理方向，而不是把视觉感知能力直接“拷贝”过去。

第二，从组件上看，high-level reasoning 的提升主要来自 LLM 注入，而不是 ViT 或 projector。ViT 注入对感知也没有带来同等显著的正迁移，说明视觉侧能力更受表示空间和编码细节约束，局部线性投影不够。

第三，参数范围上，linear-only 注入通常比 full-parameter 注入更稳，单位注入强度下的收益更高、干扰更小。这个结果和理论分解一致：full 注入虽然包含更多潜在有益信号，但也引入更多二阶结构冲突。

第四，层映射和注入比例都很敏感。有效 layer mapping 明显依赖具体 source-target 配对，不存在一个通用最优映射。注入比例 α 只有在较小区间内才出现正向 selective transfer；一旦 α 继续增大，性能很快被 interference 吞掉。作者把这一现象解释为一阶收益先线性增长、二阶损伤按平方项放大，因此最佳点天然落在窄小区间。

从阅读价值看，最有信息量的是这些消融：按组件拆分、按参数类型拆分、按 layer mapping 拆分、按 α 扫描的能力曲线。如果只看 aggregate score，会错过论文真正的结论。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题设定—理论分解—消融结果”三步读。

先看 Introduction 和方法图，明确 CDPI 不是为了做更强融合，而是为了测 transfer mechanism。这个定位如果没抓住，后面的实验会被误读成“为什么不用更复杂映射”。

然后重点看方法部分关于 injection space、alignment operator 和 layer mapping 的定义。这里决定了实验到底在控制什么变量。尤其要注意作者为什么区分 linear 与 full 参数，以及为什么把 ViT、Proj、LLM 分开分析。

理论部分值得细读二阶展开。核心不是公式本身，而是 A_c 和 I_c 的解释：一个代表能力相关的一阶对齐信号，一个代表结构干扰。后面所有“只在小 α 有效”“reasoning 比 perception 更能迁移”的现象，都是围绕这个框架展开的。

实验部分优先看四类图表：1）不同能力类别的增益分布；2）组件级注入对比；3）linear vs full；4）layer mapping 与 α 扫描。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要深挖，可进一步想两个问题：为什么 reasoning 更线性、而 perception 更依赖整体几何；为什么 LLM 中的可迁移方向能跨尺度保留，而视觉侧不行。这两个问题和预训练表征的可压缩性直接相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than “does fusion improve the average score?” In training-free fusion between heterogeneous, cross-scale MLLMs, what capabilities actually transfer from the larger model to the smaller one, where those transferable signals reside, and how layer mapping, parameter scope, and injection strength shape the outcome. Prior heterogeneous fusion work mostly reports aggregate gains, which makes it hard to separate genuine knowledge transfer from architectural mismatch and interference. This work reframes fusion as a local probing problem: inject a small projected parameter direction and measure capability-specific response.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. CDPI provides a concrete way to study transferability in parameter space and decomposes local transfer into a first-order beneficial signal and a second-order structural interference term. That perspective is useful beyond model fusion: it also informs cross-scale distillation, continual pretraining, parameter reuse during mid-training, and more generally the question of which capabilities are locally portable across models. The main empirical message is sharp: transfer is highly capability-selective, high-level reasoning transfers much more readily than perception, most of that gain lives in the LLM rather than the vision stack, and positive transfer only survives in a narrow low-ratio regime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection (CDPI). Given a larger source MLLM and a smaller target MLLM from the same family, the model is partitioned into three components: vision encoder (ViT), cross-modal projector, and LLM. An injection space E=(C,P) specifies which components are selected and whether the injection is restricted to linear-layer parameters or extended to all alignable parameters. Because source and target differ in hidden size, attention-head count, and LLM depth, the paper defines a heterogeneous alignment operator A_pi that projects source parameters into the target parameter space. The layer mapping pi controls how source LLM layers are matched to target layers.

After obtaining the projected source direction Δ, the target is perturbed without training: Θ_F = Θ_T + αΔ. The point is not to perform aggressive fusion, but to scan α, parameter scope, component choice, and layer mapping, and then observe capability-specific local changes.

The theoretical analysis uses a second-order expansion around the target parameters. For a capability-specific loss L_c(Θ), the local gain is approximated by a first-order term αA_c minus a second-order term proportional to α^2 I_c, where A_c = -∇L_c(Θ_T)^TΔ is the transfer signal and I_c = Δ^T H_c Δ is the curvature response. This decomposition is the conceptual center of the paper. It explains why the same injected direction can help reasoning but barely affect perception, and why gains vanish once α becomes too large: the first-order alignment may be positive, but structural interference grows quadratically.

Unlike standard model merging, the method is not trying to build the best merged model, and it does not rely on learned mappings. It is a controlled probe for transferability. One notable design choice is the comparison between linear-only and full-parameter injection. The results suggest that transferable knowledge is more concentrated in linear transformations than in the full set of alignable weights, which is an interesting clue about where portable computation lives in MLLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use four Qwen3-VL cross-scale model pairs and evaluate them on twelve benchmarks. The most informative results are capability-wise rather than aggregate.

First, gains are concentrated in reasoning, especially high-level reasoning, while perception remains close to the original target performance. This suggests that training-free cross-scale fusion is much better at transferring high-level decision or language-side computation than low-level visual competence.

Second, component-level ablations show that the LLM carries most of the high-level reasoning gains. Injecting the ViT or projector does not produce comparable positive transfer. This is consistent with the idea that visual capability is more tightly coupled to representation geometry and encoder-specific details, making it less amenable to local linear projection.

Third, restricting injection to linear-layer parameters is usually more efficient and more stable than injecting all alignable parameters. Full-parameter injection may contain more useful signal, but it also introduces substantially more structural conflict, which matches the second-order analysis.

Fourth, both layer mapping and injection ratio are highly sensitive. Effective layer mappings depend on the specific source-target pair; there is no universal best mapping. Positive selective transfer appears only in a narrow low-α regime, and performance degrades quickly as α increases, consistent with a linear benefit term competing against a quadratic interference term.

The most useful ablations are the capability breakdown, component-wise injection, linear-vs-full comparison, and α sweeps. Those are where the paper’s actual contribution sits.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: setup, theory, then ablations.

Start with the introduction and the main method figure to lock in the paper’s goal. CDPI is not proposed as a stronger fusion recipe; it is a probe for transfer mechanisms. Missing that point makes the rest look underpowered when it is actually intentionally controlled.

Then focus on the definitions of the injection space, the alignment operator, and the layer mapping. These choices determine what is being held fixed and what is being varied. Pay attention to why the paper separates ViT, projector, and LLM, and why it distinguishes linear-only from full-parameter injection.

The theory section is worth careful reading, especially the interpretation of A_c and I_c. The formula itself is simple; the value lies in the explanation. Most empirical findings in the paper are direct manifestations of that decomposition.

In the experiments, prioritize four groups of figures/tables: capability-specific gains, component-level ablations, linear vs full injection, and layer-mapping / α sweeps. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If reading more deeply, the two questions worth pursuing are: why reasoning appears more locally linear and portable than perception, and why transferable directions in the LLM survive cross-scale projection better than those in the vision stack.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫理论和能力分解图；它把模型融合从总分游戏拉回参数方向和曲率，结论需看setup干净度。
recommendation.en: Skim the theory and capability breakdowns; it moves fusion analysis beyond aggregate scores, but the setup cleanliness decides how much to trust it.

summary.core_problem: 现有模型合并方法默认专家由全参数微调得到，未考虑训练策略对合并兼容性的影响，导致合并后任务间干扰大、性能下降

summary_en.core_problem: Address the problem that existing model merging methods assume experts are obtained via full parameter fine-tuning, ignoring the impact of training strategies on merge compatibility, leading to severe inter-task interference and post-merging performance degradation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a two-stage expert training strategy that improves merge compatibility without modifying the merging algorithm itself
summary_en.technical_approach: First validate that prompt-based adaptation is a strong baseline: independently learned prompts can be reused across tasks, and fixing the backbone avoids interference from weight merging; on this basis, propose Dual-Tuned Experts (DTE), a two-stage training strategy: first learn task prompts, then fine-tune the vision encoder to reduce the magnitude of task-specific parameter updates and improve merge compatibility
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across multiple CLIP architectures, full fine-tuning, and LoRA expert settings show that DTE consistently improves the performance of standard model merging methods (abstract truncated, exact improvement margins not fully disclosed)

recommendation.zh: 模型合并方向的增量改进，仅对做多任务后训练适配与模型合并的研究员有参考，看§3的prompt基线实验即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in model merging, only relevant for researchers working on multi-task post-training adaptation and model merging, focus on the prompt baseline experiments in §3

paper.title: SiGMA: Sign-Guided Merging and Adaptation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

Prior methods mostly utilize Mixture of Experts or expansion merge approach, primarily focusing on catastrophic forgetting, yet they still suffer from negative interference during inference, where newly learned updates overwrite useful prior knowledge and degrade overall performance. To address this, we propose SiGMA (Sign Guided Merging and

summary.core_problem: 多模态持续指令调优中，新任务更新会覆盖旧知识，导致推理时负向干扰和灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 持续学习方向的方法改进，提出基于参数符号的调优与合并策略。
summary.technical_approach: SiGMA 包含两部分：训练时用符号引导的自适应调优减少与旧知识的参数冲突，推理时用符号引导的合并选择性放缩显著参数以保留任务特有知识。
summary.experiments: 在 UCIT 基准上测试，与 MoE 和 expansion merge 类方法对比，声明在遗忘和整体性能上更优，具体模型规模和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal continual instruction tuning suffers from negative interference at inference, where new task updates overwrite previously learned knowledge and cause catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in continual learning; proposes a sign-guided parameter tuning and merging strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: SiGMA has two components: sign-guided adaptive tuning during training to reduce parameter collisions with past knowledge, and sign-guided merging at inference to selectively scale salient parameters and preserve task-specific knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the UCIT benchmark against MoE and expansion merge baselines; claims better forgetting resistance and overall performance, with model scale and exact gains not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 持续指令调优的增量工作，参数符号引导思路与 TIES-Merging 同源，对预训练无直接价值，作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental continual instruction tuning work; sign-guided merging is related to TIES-Merging and has limited direct value for pretraining; keep as literature reference.

summary.core_problem: 诊断 model merging 中 pairwise alignment 看似可行但多模型全局合并不一致的问题，并在无法认证时选择 abstention。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并的理论诊断框架。它关注 checkpoint alignment 的高阶一致性，对多微调模型合并、adapter 合并和模型 soup 的可靠性有间接参考，但离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
